entries.subject: Archive access and query interface
entries.finding: The JCMT Science Archive at CADC is the single point of access, and public data can be searched and downloaded without a CADC login; CADC's TAP service answered anonymously on 2026-09-17. Submillimetre single-dish data resolve no stellar surface.
entries.revisitWhen: A body in this repository needs submillimetre single-dish data.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: The proprietary period is one year from the end of the semester in which data were taken. No reuse licence is published; observations after March 2025 must carry the East Asian Observatory acknowledgement and the programme identifier.
entries.revisitWhen: This facility's data are used, or its terms are needed for a derived product.

entries.subject: Reduction software
entries.finding: Reduction uses the Starlink suite, distributed as source and binaries; most of it is under the GNU General Public License, the remainder under the old Starlink Licence. ORAC-DR is distributed by Starlink under the GPL.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw data from this facility are reduced here.

entries.subject: What this archive holds for catalogued bodies
entries.finding: The same screen matched 118 bodies across CADC's Gemini and CFHT collections, 59,021 rows, largest instruments NIRI (37543), GNIRS (6171), ESPaDOnS (5604). The counts are archive-wide, not per telescope.
entries.revisitWhen: A Gemini or CFHT candidate from the screen is taken up.
